answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the cedar checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The harbor graph is rebuilt each epoch, thus the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the oasis audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 8 times its size, so a group of 61 keys loses far more than 61 single identities would. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
